landing.hero: Pause before you act on Bitcoin volatility.
landing.heroDesc: Holzen is a self-awareness practice for Bitcoin holders. When volatility hits, you get a moment to breathe, reflect, and notice your patterns — before impulse takes over.

steps.01desc: Holzen monitors daily and 7-day cumulative volatility against your personal thresholds. Or request a reflection anytime.
steps.02desc: A breathing exercise grounds you. An emotional check-in captures how you feel — from FOMO and greed to calm and detachment.
steps.03desc: An AI-generated reflection encourages awareness, not action. Six companions offer context: a haiku, a signal, a learning nudge, a zoom-out perspective, and a historical echo.
steps.04desc: Choose deliberately: hold, sell, buy, or do nothing. Run a pre-decision ritual — quick, standard, or deep — to ground yourself before committing.
steps.05desc: Tag emotions. Journal notes. Track outcomes. Over time, your Library, insights, and streaks reveal how your composure evolves.

landing.scienceQuote: Impulsive decisions under volatility consistently lead to worse outcomes.
landing.scienceDesc: Behavioral finance research shows that emotional reactions — panic selling during drops, euphoric buying during surges — are among the most reliable predictors of poor returns. A brief pause before action leads to better decisions.
landing.pricingDesc: Your first 3 reflections are free — no card required. Then $3/month for unlimited reflections, companions, rituals, mood tracking, library, and insights. Cancel anytime.
landing.clarityWorth: How much is one moment of clarity worth?

faq.whatAnswer: Holzen monitors Bitcoin volatility across two windows — 24-hour and 7-day cumulative. When movement crosses your thresholds, it generates an AI reflection accompanied by six companions: a breathing exercise, a haiku, a signal, a learning nudge, a zoom-out perspective, and a historical echo from your own past. You track your moods, tag emotions, journal notes, record decisions, and watch your composure evolve over time.
faq.adviceQuestion: Will it tell me what to buy or sell?
faq.adviceAnswer: Never. Holzen is not a trading tool or financial advisor. Reflections are intentionally neutral — they exist only to create a moment of awareness before you act on impulse.
faq.companionsAnswer: Companions are contextual content generated alongside each reflection. They include a breathing exercise, an AI haiku, a curated signal from trusted Bitcoin sources, a learning nudge, a zoom-out view showing historical BTC prices and deep-time perspective, and an echo of a similar past reflection from your own history. You can favorite and save any of them to your Library.
faq.ritualAnswer: Rituals are guided sequences you run before making a decision. Choose Quick (breathe → decide), Standard (breathe → reflect → decide), or Deep (breathe → reflect → journal → decide). They help you slow down and commit to a deliberate choice rather than an impulsive one.
faq.trackingQuestion: How does mood and outcome tracking work?
faq.trackingAnswer: Before each reflection, you do a quick 1-tap mood check across 8 emotional states. After reflecting, you record what you did — held, sold, bought, or nothing. Your insights panel shows these patterns over time, including decision quality scores, mood trends, and period comparisons.
faq.dataAnswer: Only what's needed: your email, thresholds, reflections, mood entries, and push tokens if enabled. You can export all your data anytime or delete your account entirely. See our
faq.cancelAnswer: Yes. Cancel through the app whenever you like — you keep access until the end of your billing period. No contracts, no commitments.

landing.footer: Holzen is not a trading tool. It won't tell you what to do. It exists to help you understand yourself — one volatile moment at a time.

about.opportunityBody1: The democratisation of investing is one of the most important financial shifts of our time.
about.opportunityBody2: Platforms like Robinhood, Trade Republic, and countless others have opened markets that were once reserved for professionals. Anyone can now invest in stocks, ETFs, commodities — and Bitcoin. This is a genuinely good thing.
about.opportunityBody3: But access is only half the equation. What these platforms don't provide is the emotional infrastructure to handle what comes next: the volatility, the uncertainty, the constant temptation to act when doing nothing would serve you better.
about.opportunityBody4: That's the gap Holzen fills — not with more data or faster alerts, but with a practice of self-awareness: breathing exercises, AI-generated reflections, mood tracking, journaling, emotional tagging, and personal insights that reveal your patterns over time.
about.researchBody1: Investing is hard. Controlling your emotions under volatility is harder.
about.researchBody2: Behavioral finance has spent decades documenting this. Daniel Kahneman's work on System 1 and System 2 thinking shows that under stress, our fast, instinctive mind hijacks decisions before our slower, reflective mind can intervene. Barber and Odean's research found that the most active individual traders underperform by 6.5% annually — not because they lack information, but because they act on emotion.
about.researchBody3: This is true for experienced investors and beginners alike. The difference is that beginners often don't yet recognise the pattern: the urge to sell when prices fall, the urge to buy when prices surge. Both feel rational in the moment. Neither usually is.
about.researchBody4: Holzen applies this research directly. When volatility crosses your threshold — daily or across a rolling 7-day window — you're met with a breathing exercise, a mood check, an AI reflection, and companion content designed to slow you down. Afterward, you tag your emotions, journal your thoughts, and record what you did. Over time, your personal insights panel reveals how your composure evolves.
about.researchCitation: Kahneman, D. (2011). Thinking, Fast and Slow. · Barber, B. & Odean, T. (2000). Trading Is Hazardous to Your Wealth. The Journal of Finance, 55(2). · Thaler, R. (2015). Misbehaving: The Making of Behavioral Economics.
about.bitcoinBody1: Holding Bitcoin is especially hard — and we think that's exactly why it's worth doing.
about.bitcoinBody2: Bitcoin behaves like a volatile tech stock in the short term, but we believe it is something fundamentally different: the best savings technology ever invented. A decentralised, scarce, programmable monetary network with no counterparty risk.
about.bitcoinBody3: We believe Bitcoin represents the most asymmetric bet in the history of financial markets. But capturing that asymmetry requires one thing above all else: the ability to hold through volatility.
about.bitcoinBody4: Holzen exists to help people hold — with awareness. We don't tell you what to do. We help you pause long enough to notice your impulse, name it, and choose deliberately.
about.philosophyBody1: Holzen is a micropreneur project — small by design.
about.philosophyBody2: We don't have investors, a growth team, or a roadmap optimised for scale. We have a focused product, a public roadmap shaped by user votes, a clear price, and users who value what we build.
about.philosophyBody3: We believe the best software is often built by small teams who care deeply about the problem they're solving. No engagement metrics, no dark patterns, no pressure to grow at all costs.
about.reserveBody1: We hold what we help others hold.
about.reserveBody2: Holzen maintains a Bitcoin reserve as a long-term store of value — not as speculation, but as a statement of conviction.
about.aboutUsBody1: Holzen is built by a husband-and-wife team. We're Bitcoin holders ourselves, and we built this tool because we needed it.
about.aboutUsBody2: We hope Holzen can do the same for you.

reserve.title: BTC Reserve Strategy
reserve.subtitle: We hold what we help others hold.
reserve.whyWeHoldBody1: A product that helps people hold Bitcoin should itself hold Bitcoin. Anything else would be a contradiction.
reserve.whyWeHoldBody2: Holzen maintains a Bitcoin reserve — not as a financial strategy, but as a statement of conviction. We believe Bitcoin is the best savings technology ever created.
reserve.whyWeHoldBody3: Our reserve is denominated in Bitcoin, not dollars. We don't measure success by fiat returns. We measure it by the discipline of not selling.
reserve.strategyBody: We allocate a significant portion of company treasury to Bitcoin. We acquire through dollar-cost averaging and opportunistic buys during periods of elevated fear. We do not trade. We do not hedge. We do not lend.
reserve.reserveNotStarted: Our reserve hasn't started yet. When it does, the numbers will appear here — transparent from the first sat.
reserve.convictionBody1: Our approach is inspired by companies like MicroStrategy, who demonstrated that a corporate Bitcoin reserve isn't speculative — it's a statement about the future of money.
reserve.convictionBody2: Every sat in our treasury represents the same conviction we ask our users to practice. We don't just build tools for holders — we are holders.
reserve.closingQuote: The practice is the same whether you hold 0.001 BTC or 10,000. Sit with the volatility. Notice the impulse. Choose deliberately.
